newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan car shares driven higher by weakening yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan car shares driven higher by weakening yen.

text.p: Shares in Japanese car makers were driven higher in Tuesday morning trade on the back of the weakening yen, which fell further against the dollar overnight, brokers said.

Shares in Honda Motor Co Ltd were 50 yen higher at 2,750 yen at 0113 GMT, with a turnover of 1.22 million shares, ranking eighth on the most-heavily traded list of Tokyo Stock Exchange first section shares. Toyota Motor Corp was up 30 yen at 2,730 yen, with a turnover of 1.23 million shares, ranking seventh.
"Investors are being encouraged to buy car shares by the long-term merit of a weak yen against the dollar," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
